name: airlock
description: Add intentional friction before accessing distracting websites.

scripts.package:firefox: npm run build && node scripts/release.js prepare && web-ext lint --source-dir store/firefox-source --no-config-discovery && web-ext build --source-dir store/firefox-source --artifacts-dir store --filename firefox-addon-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest --no-config-discovery
scripts.submit:firefox: web-ext sign --source-dir store/firefox-source --artifacts-dir store --channel listed --amo-metadata store/amo-metadata.json --approval-timeout 0 --no-input --no-config-discovery
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:browser:chromium && npm run test:browser:firefox
